## mep delete, item sessions

- `mep delete MESSAGE_ID` deletes one of your own messages, at once and irreversibly. It checks read-only that the message is yours, then prints `deleted SOURCE message ID`; exit 1 with a reason when it is not yours, does not exist, or the organization disallows deletion or its time limit has passed.
- Items carry the Claude Code sessions that work on them: `mep set|add --session UUID[@CWD]`, and `mep resume ITEM` prints `cd CWD && claude --resume UUID`.
- `mep sync` no longer re-appends a change the remote already has. Drafts and items from newer versions load in older ones. `mep update` says when PyPI lags. `mep edit` explains "Invalid message(s)".
